title: Hawaii Surcharge Refunds on Crestline Companion Bookings: Desk Reference
content:
When a companion booking that carried a Hawaii surcharge is cancelled, the surcharge is refunded to the holder by the companion desk in one refund entry that names that Hawaii surcharge charge. This applies to every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes on which a Hawaii surcharge was charged.

The refund of a cancelled booking's Hawaii surcharge is fixed only after the certificate's ledger carries the refund of that booking's companion fare. Until the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass shows that booking's companion fare refunded, the amount of the Hawaii surcharge refund is not fixed.

## Capability

`refund_companion_hawaii_surcharge_2c74daac` records, on the trip and charge history of one certificate or pass, one refund of component Hawaii surcharge dated the current business date, naming the Hawaii surcharge charge it refunds and carrying that charge's companion ticket number. The holder's companion charges fall by the amount refunded, and the holder sees the refund on the certificate or pass.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks `refund_companion_hawaii_surcharge_2c74daac` and then calls it; it is an agent-side tool of the companion desk.

## Parameters

- `companion_id` — reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the refund is recorded on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup.
- `reversed_entry_id` — reference number of the Hawaii surcharge charge entry being refunded, as returned by the companion trip and charge history lookup.
- `amount` — the Hawaii surcharge amount refunded, in USD, a decimal number rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative.

These parameters are the values supplied at the call; their presence adds no question to the holder.

## Return

A receipt listing `refund_entry_id` (reference of the new refund), `companion_id`, `refunded_charge_entry_id` (the charge refunded), `charge_component` (always `hawaii_surcharge`), `amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status`, which reads `refund_recorded` when the refund is on file. No error receipt is defined.
